description: Grade a single package name (and optional version): typosquat distance against a bundled popular-names list and version pattern checks offline; with online true, registry checks for version age under 7 days, publisher change versus the previous version, provenance attestation, and deprecation.

content.description: Also run content mode against the greatest lower published version (default false)

name.description: Package name, for example lodash or @scope/name

online.description: Also run npm registry checks (default false)

version.description: Version to check (default: offline name checks only, or the registry latest when online)

name: check_package
